description: ANXA2R ortholog conservation profile, amphipathic helix (hydrophobic moment) analysis with alpha-synuclein/ApoA-I controls, and Foldseek structural search of the AlphaFold model against PDB100/AFDB
code:
import requests, json, numpy as np, time, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"Content-Type":"application/json","User-Agent":"research-agent"}
S=("MEQHFLGCVKRAWDSAEVAPEPQPPPIVSSEDRGPWPLPLYPVLGEYSLDSCDLGLLSSPCWRLPGVYWQNGLSPGVQSTLEPSTAKPTEFSWPGTQKQQEAPVEEVGQAEEPDRLRLQQ"
   "LPWSSPLHPWDRQQDTEVCDSGCLLERRHPPALQPWRHLPGFSDCLEWILRVGFAAFSVLWACCSRICGAKQP")
HESSA={'A':0.11,'C':-0.13,'D':3.49,'E':2.68,'F':-0.32,'G':0.74,'H':2.06,'I':-0.60,'K':2.71,
       'L':-0.55,'M':-0.10,'N':2.05,'P':2.23,'Q':2.36,'R':2.58,'S':0.84,'T':0.52,'V':-0.31,'W':0.30,'Y':0.68}
KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,
    'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}

# ---------- A. per-column conservation from the Compara protein alignment ----------
o=requests.get("https://rest.ensembl.org/homology/id/human/ENSG00000177721?type=orthologues;sequence=protein",
               headers=H,timeout=240).json()["data"][0]["homologies"]
# build set of pairwise alignments mapped onto human columns
hum_cols=None; per_res_match=np.zeros(193); per_res_n=np.zeros(193)
seen=set()
for h in o:
    sp=h["target"]["species"]
    key=(sp,h["target"]["id"])
    if key in seen: continue
    seen.add(key)
    a=h["source"]["align_seq"]; b=h["target"]["align_seq"]
    pos=0
    for ca,cb in zip(a,b):
        if ca!="-":
            if pos<193:
                per_res_n[pos]+=1
                if ca==cb: per_res_match[pos]+=1
            pos+=1
cons = per_res_match/np.maximum(per_res_n,1)
print("unique ortholog alignments used:", len(seen))
print("mean per-residue identity across whole protein: %.3f" % cons.mean())
regions={"N-term 1-30":(1,30),"mid disordered 78-148":(78,148),
         "C-term hydrophobic 165-190":(165,190),"very C-term 186-193":(186,193)}
for lab,(a,b) in regions.items():
    print(f"  {lab:28s} mean identity {cons[a-1:b].mean():.3f}")

# non-primate orthologs only (identity to human < 60%)
nonprim=[h for h in o if h["target"]["perc_id"]<60]
pm=np.zeros(193); pn=np.zeros(193)
for h in nonprim:
    a=h["source"]["align_seq"]; b=h["target"]["align_seq"]; pos=0
    for ca,cb in zip(a,b):
        if ca!="-":
            if pos<193:
                pn[pos]+=1
                if ca==cb: pm[pos]+=1
            pos+=1
cons_np=pm/np.maximum(pn,1)
print("\nNon-primate orthologs only (n=%d alignments):" % len(nonprim))
for lab,(a,b) in regions.items():
    print(f"  {lab:28s} mean identity {cons_np[a-1:b].mean():.3f}")

# ---------- B. hydrophobic moment (amphipathic helix) ----------
def eisenberg():
    return {'A':0.62,'R':-2.53,'N':-0.78,'D':-0.90,'C':0.29,'Q':-0.85,'E':-0.74,'G':0.48,'H':-0.40,
            'I':1.38,'L':1.06,'K':-1.50,'M':0.64,'F':1.19,'P':0.12,'S':-0.18,'T':-0.05,'W':0.81,'Y':0.26,'V':1.08}
E=eisenberg()
def muH(seq,delta=100.0):
    ang=np.deg2rad(delta*np.arange(len(seq)))
    h=np.array([E[a] for a in seq])
    return np.sqrt((h*np.cos(ang)).sum()**2+(h*np.sin(ang)).sum()**2)/len(seq)
w=18
mu=np.full(193,np.nan); hm=np.full(193,np.nan)
for i in range(193-w+1):
    mu[i+w//2]=muH(S[i:i+w]); hm[i+w//2]=np.mean([E[a] for a in S[i:i+w]])
best=int(np.nanargmax(mu))
print(f"\nMax hydrophobic moment <muH> (w=18, 100 deg) = {np.nanmax(mu):.3f} at res {best+1}: {S[best-8:best+10]}")
print("  Classical amphipathic lipid-binding helices (apolipoproteins, BAR/ALPS, alpha-synuclein) have <muH> ~0.45-0.65.")
print("  <muH> values here (top 5 windows):")
for i in np.argsort(-np.nan_to_num(mu))[:5]:
    print(f"    res {i-8}-{i+9}: muH={mu[i]:.3f} <H>={hm[i]:+.3f}  {S[max(0,i-9):i+9]}")
# alpha-synuclein control
syn=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P37840.fasta",timeout=60).text
syn="".join(syn.split("\n")[1:])
musyn=max(muH(syn[i:i+18]) for i in range(len(syn)-17))
apoa1="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P02647.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
muapo=max(muH(apoa1[i:i+18]) for i in range(len(apoa1)-17))
print(f"  control alpha-synuclein P37840 max muH = {musyn:.3f}; ApoA-I P02647 max muH = {muapo:.3f}")

# ---------- C. Foldseek search of the AF model against PDB/AFDB ----------
foldseek_ok=False
try:
    pdb=open("/tmp/AF_Q3ZCQ2.pdb","rb").read()
except Exception:
    pdb=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q3ZCQ2-F1-model_v4.pdb",timeout=120).content
try:
    r=requests.post("https://search.foldseek.com/api/ticket",
        files={"q":("AF_Q3ZCQ2.pdb",pdb)},
        data=[("mode","3diaa")]+[("database[]",d) for d in ["afdb50","pdb100","afdb-swissprot"]],
        timeout=120)
    print("\nFoldseek ticket:", r.status_code, r.text[:300])
    tid=r.json()["id"]
    for _ in range(40):
        st=requests.get(f"https://search.foldseek.com/api/ticket/{tid}",timeout=60).json()
        if st.get("status") in ("COMPLETE","ERROR"): break
        time.sleep(10)
    print("status:", st)
    if st.get("status")=="COMPLETE":
        res=requests.get(f"https://search.foldseek.com/api/result/{tid}/0",timeout=120).json()
        foldseek_ok=True
        for db in res.get("results",[]):
            als=db.get("alignments",[])
            if als and isinstance(als[0],list): als=[x for sub in als for x in sub]
            print(f"\n  DB {db.get('db')}: {len(als)} hits")
            for a in als[:10]:
                print(f"    {a.get('target','')[:55]:57s} eval={a.get('eval')} prob={a.get('prob')} seqId={a.get('seqId')} alnLen={a.get('alnLen')} qcov={a.get('qcov')}")
except Exception as ex:
    print("Foldseek failed:", repr(ex))

# ---------- figure ----------
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(11,7))
ax=axes[0]
ax.fill_between(np.arange(1,194),0,cons,color="#2b6cb0",alpha=.35,label="all 37 ortholog alignments")
ax.plot(np.arange(1,194),cons_np,color="#c53030",lw=1.4,label="non-primate orthologs only")
ax.axvspan(165,190,color="#f6e05e",alpha=.35)
ax.text(166,1.02,"best hydrophobic segment 165-190",fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("fraction identical to human"); ax.set_ylim(0,1.15); ax.set_xlim(1,193)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower left"); ax.set_title("ANXA2R conservation: the C-terminal hydrophobic segment is the best-conserved part of a poorly conserved protein")
ax=axes[1]
ax.plot(np.arange(1,194),mu,color="#2f855a",lw=1.6,label="ANXA2R <muH> (w=18)")
ax.axhline(musyn,ls="--",c="#6b46c1",lw=1); ax.text(3,musyn+0.005,f"alpha-synuclein max {musyn:.2f}",fontsize=8,color="#6b46c1")
ax.axhline(muapo,ls=":",c="#dd6b20",lw=1); ax.text(3,muapo+0.005,f"ApoA-I max {muapo:.2f}",fontsize=8,color="#dd6b20")
ax.set_ylabel("hydrophobic moment <muH>"); ax.set_xlabel("residue"); ax.set_xlim(1,193)
ax.set_title("No window reaches the amphipathic lipid-binding helix range")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
